basics.name: Arjol Pengu
basics.label: GenAI Manager | AI Solution Architect
basics.summary: GenAI Manager at PwC leading architecture, product strategy, and engineering delivery of a production AI platform for a Fortune 50 pharmaceutical client. Shipped an agentic LangGraph pipeline with hybrid RAG retrieval and 14 compliance guardrails to the client's Kubernetes environment, improving response quality from 36% to 88% while maintaining 100% regulatory safety. Prior to AI leadership, spent 5+ years building distributed Java and Python platforms across EY, 3M, and government contracts totaling $70M+ in contract value.

projects.title: AI-Powered Pharmaceutical Sales Platform (Fortune 50 Client)
projects.summary: Led architecture, product strategy, and engineering delivery of a production AI sales platform for a Fortune 50 pharmaceutical client. Owned the full lifecycle from system design through deployment across two cloud environments, managing a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and QA.
responsibilities: Architected a 24-node LangGraph agentic pipeline processing real-time healthcare conversations with deterministic compliance enforcement, deployed to the client's production Kubernetes cluster.

Designed and shipped a hybrid RAG retrieval system (pgvector + sparse search + quality gating) that improved response accuracy from 36% to 88% while maintaining 100% regulatory safety across 30 compliance probes.
Led a cross-functional engineering team across 3 parallel workstreams (guardrails, content, evaluation), creating sprint plans with day-level task assignments and dependency tracking.

Built a multi-suite AI evaluation framework covering 214 functional test cases, a 760-probe adversarial red team corpus, and behavioral tone scoring, integrated with Langfuse for observability and trend reporting.

Designed 14 AI safety guardrails (PHI detection, adverse event screening, off-label blocking, prompt injection defense) using a layered architecture: deterministic rules as the fast path, LLM-based classification for the long tail.
Delivered a 2-week remediation sprint closing 10 legal review findings (3 critical) from an external law firm assessment, coordinating 3 parallel workstreams with day-by-day engineering assignments.
Owned the platform migration from AWS ECS to the client's Kubernetes environment, creating Helm charts, CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring data parity across both production environments.
Ran 10+ live client demos and authored scenario-based talk tracks, translating technical architecture decisions into product feedback sessions with the client's product and medical-legal teams.

Authored a scalability analysis identifying 7 bottlenecks blocking 1,000+ concurrent users, modeling token throughput requirements from production traces and delivering infrastructure sizing recommendations.
Defined the product evaluation framework adopted by the client's product, engineering, and regulatory teams to measure AI quality across safety, accuracy, fidelity, and conversational tone.
achievements: Shipped a production agentic AI platform: LangGraph pipeline, hybrid RAG retrieval, semantic caching, 33 configurable skills, and 14 compliance guardrails, serving real users in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
Improved response quality from 36% to 88% on the functional evaluation suite while holding regulatory safety at 100% across all iterations.
Built and deployed a RAG ingestion pipeline processing 7 source documents into 288 provenance-tracked chunks with automated extraction, metadata tagging, and content verification.
Led a cross-functional remediation sprint that closed 3 critical regulatory findings within 2 weeks, preventing production-blocking issues before the client's launch timeline.
Authored 37 wiki pages and 64+ architecture documents, establishing the engineering team's canonical reference for system design, onboarding, and client-facing technical presentations.
